newsitem.title: USA: American Home names unit's global chief.
newsitem.headline: American Home names unit's global chief.

text.p: American Home Products Corp said Tuesday it named Robert Essner president of its unit, Wyeth-Ayerst Global Pharmaceuticals.

Previous to his appointment, Essner had been president of Wyeth-Ayerst Laboratories and responsible for the unit's domestic pharmaceutical business. He reports to Fred Hassan, executive vice president of American Home Products.

Bernard Poussot will continue as president of Wyeth-Ayerst International and will have additonal responsibilities for a newly formed global strategic marketing function, the company said. Poussot reports to Essner.

The company said the following will also report to Essner: Joseph Mahady, president, Wyeth-Ayerst Pharmaceuticals; Ronald Saldarini, president, Wyeth-Lederle Vaccines and Pediatrics and Michael Dey, president of ESI Lederdle.
The company said several global support functions will be created, all reporting to Essner, to assist both the international and U.S. businesses.
John Stafford, chairman, president and chief executive officer of American Home Products, said the organizational changes were adopted to enhance the company's worldwide operations.
